decisions.reason: Correcting the token ID shown in a mint-success popup does not change how fiat buyers access commissions, prizes, tickets, or their dashboard.
The source changes confirmation-display accuracy, not the USDC payment currency or the requirement that the USDC flow successfully mint an NFT.
The reported popup token-ID mismatch concerns the wallet USDC confirmation UI and does not change the deferred Transak fiat-mint integration.
Displaying the actual minted token ID does not alter the $15 mint price or its pricing commitments.
The source specifically reports a USDC approval-stage popup problem and does not change the ETH conversion, exact-output swap, or refund behavior.
The token ID displayed in a success popup has no necessary effect on primary-sale revenue allocations.
The source refines the independently tracked success-confirmation display and does not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited supply model.
Accurate display of the minted token ID does not change background wallet creation, custody, key control, or seed-phrase requirements for fiat buyers.
The confirmation popup defect does not change which payment methods must be selectable or unavailable.
The source does not alter payment-currency disclosure or the ability to select ETH and USDC.
The displayed token-ID correction has no effect on optional tipping, presets, custom tips, or placement.
A stale token number in the success popup does not change which previously minted token IDs are valid referral codes or the self-referral rule.
